name: Don't Wake The Pets! 🐶
desc:
🤫 Don’t Wake Up Pets!

Sneak quietly and snatch as many sleeping pets as you can! 😴
But be careful… if you wake them up, they’ll come chasing after you! 🏃‍♂️💨
Survive the chase, escape their grasp, and prove you’re the ultimate pet thief! ⚡

Having fun? Don’t forget to smash that thumbs up! 👍
